mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku (sku_id, product_id, stock_quantity, moq, status, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{productId}, #{stockQuantity}, #{moq}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.product_id AS productId, s.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.status AS status, s.moq AS moq, bp.basePrice AS basePrice,
COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(po.option_name, ':', pov.option_value) ORDER BY po.option_name SEPARATOR ', '), '' ) AS optionSummary FROM sku s LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ovs.sku_id = s.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, MAX(price) AS basePrice FROM sku_price WHERE min_qty = 1 AND max_qty IS NULL GROUP BY sku_id ) bp ON bp.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.stock_quantity, s.created_at, s.status, bp.basePrice ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT pov.option_value_id AS optionId, po.product_id AS productId, po.option_name AS optionName, pov.option_value AS optionValue FROM option_value_sku ovs JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id WHERE ovs.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY po.option_name, pov.sort_order, pov.option_value
SELECT sku_id AS skuId, status AS status, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity moq AS moq FROM sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}

SELECT sp.sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sp.sku_id AS skuId, sp.min_qty AS minQty, sp.max_qty AS maxQty, sp.price AS price, sp.created_at AS createdAt FROM sku_price sp JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = sp.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE sp.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY sp.min_qty
